protocol_differences.interpretation: Q2/Q3/Q4 are distinct follow-up run families; their metrics must not be relabeled as the Q1a V37 training runs.
The artifact run IDs encode actual date-coded seeds; logical labels 21/22/23 are shorthand only.

protocol_differences.q1a_v37: Manifest records warmup_ratio=0.2, cosine scheduler, patience=10, trial=v37, dev_macro_pragmatic_f1 selection.
protocol_differences.q2: Full follow-up manifest records warmup_ratio=0.1, linear scheduler, patience=2, system_id=xlmr_followup_full.
protocol_differences.q3: Low-resource budgets change training masks/budget and the full Q3 family records dev_sarcasm_binary_macro_f1 selection.
protocol_differences.q4: Outer run is artifact_extraction with resolved_training_config not applicable; source is the same-seed Q1a V37 checkpoint.

protocol_differences.q1a_v37: Full XLM-R variant records rationale_training=true, rationale_inference=false, beta=0.3, and uncertainty weighting enabled across eight classification tasks.
protocol_differences.q2: Ablation families explicitly remove rationale, polarity auxiliary, emotion auxiliary, uncertainty weighting, or the multi-task bundle; treat each as its named variant.
protocol_differences.q3: Q3 full/budget families are separate low-resource runs, not the Q1a optimization cohort.
protocol_differences.q4: Calibration consumes direct classification probabilities from the source V37 checkpoint; it is not rationale generation or new training.

q4_lineage_rule: Q4 primary runs are calibration/extraction follow-ups from the same-seed Q1a V37 full checkpoint; they are not independent training replicates.

seed_protocol.interpretation: Use actual date-coded seeds in provenance.
